notes: Re-extraction, attempt 2. Cash-basis school district; governmental amounts are the Total Governmental Funds column on p4 (Statements of Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Fund Balances - Cash Basis); beginning/ending cash = total fund balances 4,496,716 / 4,497,902 (cash). Total column already nets the Reclassifications column (regular instruction -50,000, pupil transportation -200,000, transfers in -300,000, transfers out +50,000); printed net transfers out of 100,000 (GF to school nutrition) used. Roll-forward: 4,496,716 + 5,573,511 - 5,472,325 - 100,000 = 4,497,902. Business-type = School Nutrition Fund (p5-6, p17); roll: 128,441 + receipts 196,460 (85,115 + 4,644 + 321 + 106,380) - 265,319 + transfer 100,000 = 159,582. Non-operating receipts 'Federal and State subsidies' 106,380 split into state 15,227 and federal 91,153 using the School Nutrition Fund schedule (p17). Business-type reported receipts 296,460 computed as operating 85,115 + non-operating 211,345 (includes the 100,000 transfer). Balance sheet = Statements of Net Position - Cash Basis, 2025 Total (governmental + business-type), p1; no liabilities. Detail: General Fund receipts from budget schedule p7-8 (other non-revenue receipt 21,128 kept in revenue so items sum to printed Total Receipts 5,024,240); General Fund disbursements from the object-level departmental pages p10-15 instead of the p9 function summary (not double counted); zero-actual lines skipped. GF printed transfers out of 150,000 (p15) plus hidden transfers of 50,000 (regular instruction) and 200,000 (pupil transportation) per p4 reclassification column are split into contra expenditure lines and other financing lines with review; detail expenditure items + contra = 4,538,852 and other financing = 400,000, together equal printed Total Disbursements 4,938,852. Activities Fund recorded account by account from p22-23 (activities budget schedule p16 omitted); All Activities transfer 50,000 shown as other financing. 2024 comparative schedules (p24-25) and county treasurer tax account schedule (p26) not recorded (prior year / pass-through). Read pages 1-26 of 26.
